title: What Does a Commercial Office Fitout Cost in Newcastle in 2026?
excerpt: A scope-first guide to planning a Newcastle office fitout budget: compare inclusions, assumptions and site-specific quotations before committing.
author: Joe Kelley
metaTitle: Commercial Fitout Cost Newcastle 2026 | Your Office Space
metaDescription: Plan a Newcastle office fitout budget with clear scope, consultant inputs, building works, furniture and relocation costs. Obtain site-specific quotes.
body:
## Start with a defined scope, not a headline rate

An office fitout budget depends on the premises condition, intended use, approvals, services, finishes, furniture and programme. A rate per square metre cannot establish a reliable project cost without those assumptions.

Earlier versions of this guide described illustrative figures as verified Newcastle market rates. We have removed those figures because the supporting evidence was insufficient. This guide now focuses on the information needed to build and compare a project-specific budget.

[Discuss your Newcastle office fitout scope with YOS](/office-fitout). We can help define the brief and coordinate the inputs needed before you compare proposals.

## Compare these budget workstreams

| Workstream | What to record before comparing quotes |
| --- | --- |
| Brief and professional inputs | Design scope, surveys, consultants, client-side management and required approvals |
| Existing premises | What is retained, repaired, removed or provided by the landlord |
| Building works and finishes | Quantities, partitions, ceilings, flooring, joinery and allowances |
| Services | Mechanical, electrical, fire, hydraulic and access requirements assessed by the appointed specialists |
| Technology | Cabling, network, meeting-room AV and security responsibilities |
| Furniture | Product specifications, quantities, finishes, delivery, installation and lead times |
| Transition | Moving, staged occupation, disruption and existing-lease exit obligations |
| Risk and cash flow | Explicit allowances, contingency, GST treatment, payment milestones and exclusions |

## Make proposals comparable

Ask each provider to identify the drawing revision, scope, exclusions, provisional allowances, validity period and programme. Record unanswered questions in a clarification register. A lower total may reflect omitted work rather than a more efficient solution.

Do not assume a space described as fitted is ready for your proposed use. Confirm landlord conditions and approval responsibilities with the appointed advisers. NSW Planning Portal guidance explains that change-of-use pathways depend on the actual proposal; it is not a blanket exemption for office works.

## Consider the whole occupancy decision

Compare renewal and relocation with the same cost categories. Include exit obligations, furniture reuse, business disruption and the date the premises can actually be occupied. Your solicitor advises on the lease; the appointed contractors, consultants and certifiers retain their respective responsibilities.

## Turn the assumptions into a brief

Use the FitOut estimator as an indicative conversation starter, then request site-specific professional inputs and quotations. The furniture-only budget guide addresses a different scope from a full building-works budget.

[Try the FitOut estimator](/resources/fitout-estimator)
